## Summary

Provide a brief summary of what this pull request introduces or fixes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or filter algorithm
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] `refactor`: Code cleanup without logic changes
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `test`: Unit test additions or fixes
- [ ] `chore`: Dependencies or build tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] Solution compiles with zero warnings (`0 Errors, 0 Warnings`).
- [ ] All unit tests pass locally (`dotnet test`).
- [ ] Follows Clean Architecture boundaries (`Core` -> `Application` -> `Infrastructure` -> `WPF`).
- [ ] Adheres to the formatting rules in `.editorconfig`.
- [ ] Commit message follows Conventional Commits format (`<type>(<scope>): <description>`).
